attributes.context: This sentence is in the 24-PAY OPTION clause, which allows teachers to elect twenty or twenty-four pays per year and makes the election irrevocable for the remainder of the fiscal year.

extraction_text: The effective date of this option may be delayed if necessitated by installation or operations problems with the changeover of the Board's computer.

attributes.context: This text is a fragment at the end of page 15, immediately before the page break to page 20 and Article 13 Salary Language, and refers to equipment and machines in schools whose earnings are determined by principals and employees.

extraction_text: Any costs resulting from installation and/or maintenance of this equipment will be paid from the funds generated. The disposition of net earnings from such machines shall be determined by the principal and employees in each school.
